judgement.doubts: Agree with the 2026-09-24 hand correction: Sadhu's all-r claim is set aside as not_credible (this is the F5 'scope jump' example). All surviving events are partial; Cao-Mehat's r<=29 is the furthest range but rests on Sadhu v1, so Cranston is kept as rests_on — the codes are identical either way. Cao-Mehat's AI disclosure ('mathematical exploration') is the one place an AI could have produced mathematics in a surviving event; the quote attributes no specific argument to the AI, so none, but if a later reading shows the AI supplied a case, Step 4 would make ai_role assisted.
